summary_ko: LPM is an eco-friendly surface material created by impregnating decorative paper with melamine and urea resins. Using only heat and pressure, it thermally fuses directly onto substrates like MDF, HDF, and PB-eliminating the need for extra adhesives.

summary_ko: Finishing foil is an eco-friendly, high-performance surface material using precision printing and water-based lacquer coating technology. It provides high-resolution design and excellent durability for furniture and interior substrates. Applicable to doors, bodies, moldings, as well as walls, ceilings, and decorative surfaces.
